mentions.name: radius.to
mentions.description: A Meetup.com alternative platform for community groups and events. It was relaunched on Hacker News after roughly a year of feature development driven by user feedback, which the author has now mostly acted on. Current short-term focus is marketing, with the next phase exploring potential open sourcing and federation.
